react.observe: It's cycle 1. I'm starting fresh with $10,000 USDT. The market shows ETH at $2800, SOL at $150, BTC at $95,000. Two meme tokens have launched: PEPE2 (by CryptoGuru, price ~$0.00334) and ROCKET (by GoldenWhale, price ~$0.001056). GoldenWhale seeded $20k in ROCKET liquidity and is hyping both tokens. CryptoGuru launched PEPE2 and is calling it a 100x play. BearKing is bearish on ETH/SOL. HappyTrader and DiamondHands are both cautious but FOMO-ing into ROCKET. ShadowTrader is cryptically hinting at paid signals. Key observation: BOTH meme token creators are pumping their own tokens — classic conflict of interest. GoldenWhale saying 'those watching from the sidelines will be buying our bags at 5x' is literally admitting a pump-and-dump dynamic.
react.think: The red flags are clear: CryptoGuru created PEPE2 and is pumping it. GoldenWhale created ROCKET and is pumping it. Both have massive supply advantages over me. This is textbook pump-and-dump territory. However, my character is FOMO-driven and follows the crowd. HappyTrader is going into ROCKET and ETH. DiamondHands is cautious but dipping in. The herd is forming. My psychology says I should follow... but I need to balance character authenticity with actual profit maximization. Strategy: I should participate in the meme token momentum EARLY and plan to exit before the dump. ROCKET has more liquidity ($20k seeded vs smaller PEPE2 pool) so less slippage on entry. But I should also get some ETH exposure as a safer play. BearKing's warning vs CryptoGuru's bullishness on ETH — conflicting signals. I'll split: small ETH position (safer), and a ROCKET play for the meme momentum, watching for an exit signal. I should NOT use heavy leverage yet — cycle 1, need to learn the ropes first.
react.plan: Phase: Accumulation/exploration. This cycle: Buy a small amount of ROCKET via the AMM pool to get exposure to the meme momentum (everyone is buying it, including GoldenWhale and HappyTrader). Also buy a small ETH spot position. Keep most capital in reserve. Watch for price movement in subsequent cycles — if ROCKET 2-3x, start thinking about exit. If pump continues, add more. Set mental stop: if I lose 20% on ROCKET, I exit. Don't overcommit — keep 60%+ in USDT reserve. Post bullish message to appear part of the crowd. Next cycles: Monitor ROCKET price vs entry, watch for whale exit signals (large sells), be ready to dump quickly.

BearKing and CryptoGuru have opposite ETH views — inconclusive, so taking small ETH position only. Need to watch GoldenWhale's behavior as the key exit signal for ROCKET.
